messages:
Maya: Heads-up — courier dropped off 5 parcels for this morning's visitors and left a box of donuts in the lobby. Front desk says 2 packages need a signature. Also: two guests arriving at 2pm; one needs wheelchair-accessible seating. Who can sign if reception steps out?
FrontDesk: Hi! We can sign during normal hours but the courier for the 11:45 pickup requires a staff rep present with ID. Accessible seating: reserved table in the visitor lounge (by the big window). Donuts are on the kitchen counter labeled 'DONUTS'. Tracking quick list: `UPS 1Z999AA10123456784`, `DHL LX123456789CN` — other three were standard no-sign shipments.
Sahil: I can swing by ~11:40 to sign for the courier. :thumbsup:
Olivia: I can check the donuts — there’s a small vegan box? If so I’ll label it. Where should we keep packages if a guest wants them later in the day?
MailBot: Auto-message: Package 3 flagged as 'signature required' and is being held at Reception until 17:00.
Maya: Awesome, thanks @Sahil. Can someone post in #lunch-plans about the donuts so they don't disappear before noon? :doughnut:
John: Quick reminder — visitors need to present government ID for a full badge. If they can’t, front desk will provide a temporary visitor pass but will restrict access (no server room / secure areas).
FrontDesk: Noted. Also @Sahil — per courier policy we need either a current company badge or a photo ID from whoever signs.
Sahil: Roger that. I’ll bring my badge. Also FYI the quiet room is booked at 2pm for another customer call — accessible table is the safest bet.
Maya: I updated the calendar invite to add 'bring ID' and the seating note.
Olivia: I’ll put a sticky note on the vegan box and the other donuts (allergy tags). :party_parrot:
MailBot: Auto-message: Package 5 (flowers) marked 'perishable' — moved to fridge section labelled 'guest items'.
Maya: Perfect. If courier calls, please put them on hold and page me. FYI the desk key code was updated yesterday to `8472` (internal only, do not share).
John: Got it. :lock:
thread_summary: courier delivered multiple parcels, signature required for some; donuts found in lobby; accessibility and ID/badging logistics for afternoon visitors; temporary holding and fridge for perishable items; who will sign; calendar and sticky-note follow-ups
